character_case_trap.issue: C1152 ALLOWS differing character lengths between a case value and the selector, and character comparison blank-pads the shorter operand. A length-differing match is therefore meaningful - but a plan relying on that accidentally would prove nothing.
character_case_trap.verdict: the packet states the semantics explicitly rather than inferring them, and no plan assumes a particular character kind exists

observability_discipline.principle: Which block executed is plainly observable; which condition or selector was evaluated is NOT, and there is no short-circuit guarantee anywhere in Fortran.
observability_discipline.verified: Plans assert only which block ran, using sentinels distinct from every value any block could write so the assertion cannot succeed for the wrong reason. No plan infers evaluation from a side effect or counts invocations.
observability_discipline.scoping: The unobservability claim about condition and selector evaluation is scoped precisely and does NOT suppress the observable block-selection fact. An overbroad claim would itself be a defect.
